text:
Marc (Sales): Heads-up 11 Irene from Beacon wants the POC to guarantee regional residency: EU users processed in EU, APAC users in APAC. They require KMS keys to remain in-region and want the POC to avoid exporting any request-level metadata off-region. Can ops confirm feasibility + delta pricing?

Eva (SE): We can do tenant-level region pins for the POC and either platform-managed keys scoped to the region or BYOK imported into the cloud KMS in that region. Metadata: control-plane billing/audit records normally live in our control plane region but we can route audit logs to a customer bucket. Need to confirm which specific metadata they consider sensitive (IP, headers, UA?).

Irene_Client: They consider IP and request headers sensitive. Also: will any background jobs (embeddings indexing, async evals) touch data outside the pinned region? Kickoff is Tue 2026-04-13 if we can get this done.

Li (Legal): We need the per-region sub-processor list (EU, APAC) and a short POC attestation that, for the trial period, no PII-bearing logs or backups will be exported off the tenants pinned region. We'll also provide SOC2/ISO artifacts.

Kai (Infra): Ops notes: For a 14-day POC we can satisfy this with the following changes: 1) create tenant routing entries (pin), 2) provision region-scoped KMS (BYOK import or our key), 3) configure customer log sink (S3/GCS) in-region for control-plane audit logs, 4) disable cross-region backups and analytics exports for the tenant. Work estimate: 8-20 hours depending on BYOK/HSM import complexity. If they insist sub-processors must be physically only in-region that is a blocker (some managed services replicate metadata to control plane).

Marc (Sales): Pricing ask from Beacon: please give a POC quote that includes setup + per-region KMS handling + any surcharge for isolating backups. They want a line item they can get approved quickly.

Eva (SE): Quick ballpark (internal):
- POC setup (routing + log sink + config): $550 one-time
- BYOK import / HSM handling: $150 one-time (HSM import adds ~24-48h validation)
- Key management surcharge: $75/month per region (pro-rated for POC)
- Backup isolation ops: $0 for POC (ops hours included), production-grade isolation billed separately

Note: cross-region failover (if requested) adds reserved capacity costs + potential egress; estimate $180/mo for POC scale.

Irene_Client: Can you share the exact API call wed toggle to pin a tenant and how to query the effective region? We need to include this in our onboarding doc. Also please confirm control-plane log sink pattern.

Eva (SE): API examples (internal preview):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/beacon/pin \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"region":"europe-west1","kms_key":"projects/beacon/locations/europe-west1/keys/bc-key"}'

# query effective routing
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/beacon/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
```
Log sink: we create a delivery job that writes control-plane audit logs to the customer bucket (s3://beacon-redwood-logs-eu) using a temporary write role. This avoids control-plane retention in our central region for the POC.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: tenant-pin-2402004567. ID: dp-240200-7. Manual infra approval required.

Kai (Infra): Follow-ups: 1) I'll post the per-region sub-processor list in a DM to legal (it's short: cloud provider networking, managed KMS, metrics agent) and summarize non-sensitive copies here, 2) confirm HSM import lead time (will post), 3) schedule the tenant pin job.

Li (Legal): Once Ive seen the sub-processor list and the control-plane log sink plan I'll prepare the POC attestation. If any backup snapshots are retained off-region we need to flag it.

Marc (Sales): I'll send Beacon the POC quote, the API snippet, and a note that we can route audit logs to their EU bucket. @kai_infra please reply here when the infra approval is done. :thumbsup:

Irene_Client: Thanks 1 We need the sub-processor list + attestation by EOD tomorrow to proceed with the Tue kickoff.

Kai (Infra): Acknowledged. I'll update this thread with the final list and schedule.
